Agent Name: Verification_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: After encountering a missing dataset, the agent generated and used a synthetic dataset to identify the “smallest house,” then treated the result (900 sqft) as valid. This deviated from the requirement to verify against real Zillow data and to ensure the dataset’s representativeness. Using fabricated data led to an incorrect solution relative to the real-world answer (1148 sqft).
